files.content:
$schema: ../../.px/schemas/ontology.schema.json
schemaVersion: 1
ontology:
  id: abc123
  name: Al Dente Supply Chain
concepts: ./concepts
datasources:
- ./datasources/snowflake_prod.yaml
ontologySchema: ./ontology/schema.yaml

$schema: ../../../.px/schemas/datasource.schema.json
name: snowflake_prod
type: snowflake
host: acme.snowflakecomputing.com
database_name: PROD

$schema: ../../../.px/schemas/concept-meta.schema.json
conceptType: logic
outputPredicate: customer
group: ingest
description: Ingest customers.
fields:
- name: Id
  type: string
- name: Name
  type: string
annotations:
  bind_annotations:
    input: []
    output: '@bind("customer","parquet","disk/results/abc123","customer")'

$schema: ../../../.px/schemas/concept-meta.schema.json
conceptType: logic
outputPredicate: risk
fields:
- name: Id
  type: string
